case_title: DEMISSIE, ADISU TURKU VS SAENZ, JUAN JR. et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY DEMISSIE, ADISU TURKU AS TO DEFENDANT SAENZ, JUAN JR. QUIRARTE, ANDRE GERMAN MOTORS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-27-1999 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DEMISSIE, ADISU TURKU RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SAENZ, JUAN JR. QUIRARTE, ANDRE GERMAN MOTORS $1,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $20.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,520.00, GERMAN MOTORS IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
